newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, BT down on German setback.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, BT down on German setback.

text.p: UK shares were mixed at the start of trading on Wednesday, unsettled by a weak close on Wall Street as markets pause for breath after recent strong gains, traders said.
But the FTSE 100 bounced back from an early decline to be up 1.8 points at 4,037.4 by 0744 GMT, with gainers outweighing decliners five-to-three.
BT led the early decline after one of the company's German partners quit to join a rival telecommuncations alliance and Glaxo Wellcome fell after a Lehman Brothers downgrade.
